name: ComboSim
description: A rhythm-game-style combo trainer for video games. Players practice champion combos by pressing keys in time with video demonstrations. Currently supports League of Legends with 150 champions and 800+ combos.

capabilities.combo_practice: Users press keyboard/mouse/controller keys timed to video playback and receive accuracy grades (Perfect/Great/Good/Miss)
capabilities.champion_browser: Browse and search 150 League of Legends champions with role and difficulty filters
capabilities.key_remapping: Fully rebindable keyboard, mouse, and Xbox controller inputs
capabilities.mobile_tap_mode: On touch devices, users tap anywhere to the rhythm without needing specific keys
capabilities.combo_editing: Users can click combo steps to reassign keys with video frame preview at each timestamp
capabilities.timing_grades: Scoring based on millisecond accuracy — Perfect (≤16ms), Great (≤40ms), Good (≤80ms), Miss (>80ms) in Normal mode
capabilities.difficulty_modes: Easy, Normal, and Strict modes with different timing windows
capabilities.stats_tracking: Accuracy percentage, combo streaks, unstable rate (osu!-style), session history

champion.name: string — display name
champion.title: string — champion title
champion.roles: array of: fighter, assassin, mage, marksman, tank, support

combo.name: string — combo name
combo.inputs: array of {key, time, label, window, action}

input.key: string — display key (Q, W, E, R, A, F, D, 1-4, M1-M5)
input.time: number — timestamp in seconds within the video
input.action: string — spell1, spell2, spell3, spell4, summoner1, summoner2, autoattack, item1-4

to_practice_a_combo: GET /data/combos/{championId}.json to get combos for a champion
Navigate to /play/{championId}/{comboId} to load the combo player
Press SPACE to reset the combo position
Press the first key to start (always graded Perfect)
Press subsequent keys timed to the video playback
Each key press is graded based on timing accuracy
interaction_guide.to_find_combos_for_a_champion: GET /data/combos/{championId}.json — returns all combos with timing data
interaction_guide.to_search_champions: GET /data/champions.json and filter the champions array by name, role, or difficulty
